name: Fascia, 4,800 × 900 mm (street front)
how: Black aluminium composite panel (3 mm ACM). The frame is 40 mm Sunset LED neon flex; the Mark and lettering are built-up channel letters, 50 mm deep, Sunset acrylic faces, face-lit (warm white LEDs behind Sunset acrylic). Lit dusk to 22:00 on a timer.

name: Fascia, 2,400 × 600 mm (mall bulkhead, narrow fronts)
how: Black ACM panel. Frame, Mark and lettering in 10 mm flat-cut Sunset acrylic, pinned 20 mm off the panel and halo-lit (white LEDs behind). Check the centre's signage criteria first.

name: Projecting blade sign, Ø600 mm (double-sided)
how: Round double-sided lightbox, 120 mm deep, black powder-coated, on a wall bracket at least 2,400 mm above the pavement. Faces: black-printed opal acrylic with the artwork left clear so it glows Sunset (or Sunset vinyl on opal). Same artwork both sides.

name: Window poster, 1,000 × 1,250 mm
how: Printed on the back of clear window film (or on a black foamboard panel hung 50 mm behind the glass). The window-poster frame: our oldest brand code, the store window itself.

name: Door vinyl (sample hours)
how: Cut Sunset vinyl, applied to the outside of the door glass at eye level (centre 1,500 mm from the floor). One colour, no background.

name: Glass manifestation band, 1,000 × 80 mm (tiles every 250 mm)
how: Cut vinyl, one colour, no background: weeded and applied with transfer tape. Sunset (or etch-effect frost) on every glass door and full-height pane, two bands centred 1,000 mm and 1,500 mm from the floor, so nobody walks into the glass (SANS 10400-N). The pattern repeats every 250 mm: run it the full width of the glass.

name: Window Mark, Ø600 mm
how: Cut vinyl, one colour, no background: weeded and applied with transfer tape. Sunset, on the main window, centre 1,700 mm from the floor. Reverse-cut and applied from inside for a clean face that can't be scratched off.

name: Members-only notice, 420 × 150 mm
how: Cut vinyl, one colour, no background: weeded and applied with transfer tape. Sunset, on the door glass beside the hours, centre 1,500 mm. Required wording: we sell to members only, adults 18+.

name: Store name, Hillcrest, 900 × 200 mm
how: Cut vinyl, one colour, no background: weeded and applied with transfer tape. Sunset, along the top of the main window (top of the letters 100 mm below the frame), or on the fanlight above the door.

name: Store name, Hilton, 900 × 200 mm
how: Cut vinyl, one colour, no background: weeded and applied with transfer tape. Sunset, along the top of the main window (top of the letters 100 mm below the frame), or on the fanlight above the door.

name: Feature-wall Mark, Ø1,200 mm (illuminated)
how: The Mark on the black feature wall behind the counter, centre 1,900 mm from the floor: built-up channel letters 60 mm deep, Sunset acrylic faces, face-lit with warm white LEDs (or 30 mm Sunset neon flex on a black backing routed to this shape). This file is the face, cut as drawn.

name: Counter sign: Pay here, 900 × 260 mm (hanging, double-sided)
how: 6 mm black acrylic, letters in Sunset vinyl (or UV-printed) on both faces, hung on two steel cables over the cash wrap, bottom edge 2,300 mm from the floor.

name: Counter sign: Click & collect, 900 × 260 mm (hanging, double-sided)
how: 6 mm black acrylic, letters in Sunset vinyl (or UV-printed) on both faces, hung on two steel cables over the cash wrap, bottom edge 2,300 mm from the floor.

name: Dispensary sign, 600 × 200 mm
how: 3 mm black ACM, Sunset vinyl, screwed to the wall beside the dispensary counter at 1,800 mm. Plain wording only: no product names, no claims.

name: Fitting room, 300 × 420 mm
how: 3 mm black ACM, Sunset vinyl, on the curtain rail bracket or the wall beside it at 1,600 mm.

name: Bay header: CBD Wellness, 1,000 × 150 mm
how: 3 mm black ACM header on top of each 1,000 mm shelving bay (Hilton layout), letters in Sunset vinyl or UV print. Clips to the bay uprights.

name: Mural: Holland, meet the Hills, 2,400 × 1,600 mm
how: Feature wall opposite the counter (the Christians Village and Hilton concept). Print on matte vinyl wallpaper, or paint by colour: the sky is seven flat bands, the sun is Sunset #F5913C, the hills four flat browns to black (hex values in the file; mix to match, low-sheen acrylic). Scale up or down evenly to fit the wall.

name: Framed print: Holland, meet the Hills, A1 594 × 841 mm
how: Giclée or UV print on 300 g matte art paper, black aluminium frame with a 50 mm cream mount. A1 portrait.

name: Framed print: the Mark, A1 594 × 841 mm
how: Print on 300 g matte art paper, black frame, no mount (full bleed to the frame). A1 portrait.

name: Framed print: Dutch heritage, African soil, A1 594 × 841 mm
how: Print on 300 g matte art paper, black frame. A1 portrait. Hang as a pair with the Mark print.
